name: renku-cloud
description: Renku filmmaking skills connected to Renku Cloud: nothing to install on your computer.

interface.shortDescription: Movie-making skills for writers and filmmakers, running in Renku Cloud.
interface.longDescription: Renku Cloud runs Renku Studio for you at app.gorenku.com. This plugin adds the Renku filmmaking skills and connects them to your Renku Cloud account; sign in once when your AI app asks.
defaultPrompt: Use Renku to help with this movie-making workflow.
For screenplay work, use $screenplay-drafter to author persisted Renku Studio screenplay JSON.
For screenplay PDF conversion, use $screenplay-pdf-to-fdx to reconstruct and validate an editor-ready FDX file.
